design_decision_of_record.anchor_strength: ENFORCED v1: tutor (courseRef ?? session), CLA CHECK (questionId), Smart Mark (attempt) — all through the course_registry bridge where needed. OPEN + DISCLOSED: CLA non-CHECK kinds (node/note anchors do not reach a slug), tutor blank-courseRef-no-session (parity keeps the field optional), the 45 registry courses without curriculumCode (operator backfill is the named fix). The gate NEVER fabricates an anchor and never becomes an existence oracle.
